title: The Crown of Highmoor
author: Wren Thornbury
blurb: Wren Quintana, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
